name: Wilma K. Hardy (Simons)
sources: Ancestry.com, public member tree "Kulp-Ritchey-Dorsett Family Tree" (tree 4662169)
notes: Born 30 Mar 1924 at Chadron, Nebraska; married Elmer Simons on 30 Aug 1947 in Franklin County, Washington; died 10 Aug 1989 in Franklin County (Kulp-Ritchey-Dorsett Family Tree). She and Elmer adopted Carl Ray (1954) and Debra Sue; Carl Ray's 2025 obituary names his parents as Wilma and Elmer.
